task_summary: UNI2-h (+Phikon comparison) and blinded morphology fusion for MSI, KRAS, Tier-1 genes

steps.title: Define task labels and eligibility
steps.description: Task A MSI-H vs MSS (COAD+READ+STAD, ESCA excluded). Task B KRAS-mut vs KRAS-WT in MSS COAD/READ, sequenced, non-hypermutated; primary WT arm includes BRAF-mut (14), sensitivity analysis excludes them. One slide per patient for training; QC-flagged slides (crush, out of focus, <30 mm2 tissue) excluded.

steps.title: Confirm Tier-1 gene counts per stratum
steps.description: Tabulate mutated vs WT patients (sequenced, MSS, non-hypermutated) per cancer for TP53, PIK3CA, APC, SMAD4 (COADREAD and STAD) and CDH1 (STAD), plus % MSI-H among mutants. Keep a gene/cancer task only if the smaller arm has >=50 patients (30-49 = exploratory, flagged); save the count table as an artifact.

steps.title: Lock held-out test split by site
steps.description: Assign ~20% of patients to a locked test set grouped by tissue source site and stratified on label x project; remaining dev set gets 5 site-grouped CV folds. One patient-level split shared by all tasks. Within dev, mark a 'discovery' subset reserved for morphology hypothesis generation. Save split file as artifact immediately.

steps.title: Write pre-registration document
steps.description: Record the final gene/task list, labels, metrics (AUROC with bootstrap CI, calibration, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all gene tasks), mandatory baselines (project-only, site-only, MSI-only, stage, Claude-scored grade), CDH1 as pre-declared positive control, and the rule that the test set and CPTAC are opened once at the end.

steps.title: Build CPTAC-COAD external manifest
steps.description: Join IDC cptac_coad FFPE H&E series (178 patients) to cBioPortal coad_cptac_2019 MSI_STATUS and KRAS/BRAF/TP53/PIK3CA/APC/SMAD4 calls; report usable counts per task (external test only where both arms >=15) and flag frozen vs FFPE slides.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Features on Modal (approval per run)

steps.title: Verify UNI2-h access and pretraining data
steps.description: Re-test the HUGGINGFACE token on MahmoodLab/UNI2-h and the MahmoodLab/UNI2-h-features dataset; confirm from the model card/paper that UNI2-h pretraining excludes TCGA and CPTAC (if not explicit, fall back to UNI v1 as primary).

steps.title: Audit pre-extracted UNI2-h feature coverage
steps.description: List the TCGA-COAD/READ/STAD and CPTAC-COAD files in UNI2-h-features; check slide-ID match to our manifest, presence of tile coordinates, magnification/patch size, tile counts and download size. Download one project tar to the Modal volume as a test.

steps.title: Estimate cost and get approval
steps.description: Present costs for: downloading UNI2-h features to the Modal volume, our own extraction for any uncovered slides (UNI2-h or UNI v1 on T4/L4), and the Phikon comparison run (~$10 TCGA + ~$2-3 CPTAC). Wait for explicit user approval before each launch; stay under the $40 cap.

steps.title: Extract Phikon features TCGA + CPTAC
steps.description: Obtain UNI2-h features (pre-extracted, or our extraction for gaps), then run Phikon with the 50-slide-batch conventions (0.5 um/px, 224 px, tissue mask, 4,000-tile cap, seed 0) as the contamination comparison; delete raw slides per batch only if user approves; check billing after each run.

steps.title: Train tissue-type probe on NCT-CRC-HE-100K
steps.description: Embed the public 9-class CRC tissue dataset (224 px, 0.5 um/px) with UNI2-h, train a linear probe, validate on CRC-VAL-HE-7K, and apply to every TCGA/CPTAC tile to get tumour/stroma/lymphocyte/mucin/muscle/normal maps.

steps.title: Train MSI gated-attention MIL
steps.description: Gated ABMIL on UNI2-h features (primary) and Phikon features (comparison) (tumour-tile restricted and all-tile variants), 5 site-grouped CV folds on dev set on T4; save out-of-fold predictions and attention weights; report AUROC per project with CIs and confounder baselines.

steps.title: Train KRAS gated-attention MIL
steps.description: Same architecture on MSS COAD/READ dev set; report AUROC with CIs, plus project-only and site-only baselines; save out-of-fold predictions and attention weights.

steps.title: Train Tier-1 gene and CDH1 models
steps.description: Same ABMIL recipe and folds for each gene/cancer task that passed the count rule (TP53, PIK3CA, APC, SMAD4; CDH1 in STAD as positive control), MSS-restricted; report AUROC with CIs, MSI-only and project/site baselines, FDR-adjusted; save out-of-fold predictions and attention weights. Explanation cards built for these, but full morphology rubric only for MSI and KRAS.

steps.title: Build per-slide explanation cards
steps.description: For each dev slide and each task: attention heatmap, top-8 and bottom-8 tiles, tissue-type composition of top tiles vs whole slide, and occlusion test (score change after removing top-k tiles) to check that attention is faithful.

steps.title: Blinded description of top tiles
steps.description: Claude reads top-attention tiles without labels using a fixed checklist; aggregate which patterns recur in high-scoring vs low-scoring slides, per task.

steps.title: Discovery reads on discovery subset
steps.description: Open-ended blinded comparisons on discovery-subset slides only (tumour-restricted fields, one field per image) to generate candidate MSI and KRAS features, including grade.

steps.title: Freeze rubric and score slides blinded
steps.description: Convert candidates into a fixed 0-3 rubric (including differentiation grade and section quality), freeze it, then score every dev, test and CPTAC slide one slide at a time, blinded; present token/cost estimate before the full scoring run.

steps.title: Quantify interpretable tissue features
steps.description: Nuclear segmentation (e.g. StarDist H&E) on tumour tiles for TIL density, nuclear size/pleomorphism, plus tissue-probe fractions (mucin, stroma, lymphocytes, signet-ring-like/diffuse pattern for CDH1); produce a per-slide interpretable feature table.

steps.title: Fit fused classifier on out-of-fold scores
steps.description: Stacked logistic regression combining the UNI2-h ABMIL score, frozen rubric scores and morphometrics on dev out-of-fold data for MSI and KRAS (Phikon + morphometrics only for extra genes); test whether KRAS signal survives adjustment for Claude-scored grade.

steps.title: Open locked test and CPTAC once
steps.description: Evaluate UNI2-h alone vs Phikon alone vs rubric alone vs fused model on the locked TCGA test set and CPTAC-COAD for every pre-registered task; paired bootstrap for AUROC differences; FDR across gene tasks; compare the TCGA-vs-CPTAC gap of Phikon against UNI2-h as the contamination estimate.

steps.title: Write report and Jamboree figures
steps.description: Final report with per-slide explanation examples, ROC curves per gene, a gene-by-gene summary panel, feature-importance of the fused model, and an honest limits section; all files saved as artifacts.

desired_outputs: Tier-1 gene count table per stratum and final pre-registered task list
Locked split file (dev/test by tissue source site) and CPTAC external manifest with labels
Pre-registration document (tasks, labels, metrics, decision rules)
UNI2-h (primary) and Phikon (comparison) features for full TCGA cohort + CPTAC-COAD on Modal volume, with coverage audit
MSI, KRAS and Tier-1 gene/CDH1 ABMIL models with out-of-fold and test predictions, AUROC with CIs, FDR and confounder baselines
Per-slide explanation cards (heatmap, top tiles, tissue composition, blinded description, occlusion test)
Frozen morphology rubric and blinded per-slide rubric scores
Fused classifier results vs Phikon alone on locked test and CPTAC

feasibility.rationale: MSI from H&E is well established, but KRAS and the extra genes have weak expected signal (AUROC ~0.6–0.7) and some may fall below n=50 per arm once restricted to MSS; the pre-extracted UNI2-h features may not cover every slide or include coordinates, which would require our own extraction near the $40 cap.
